SELECT A.MENU_NO, A.MENU_ORDR , A.MENU_NM , A.UPPER_MENU_NO, A.MENU_DC, A.PROGRM_FILE_NM , A.RELATE_IMAGE_PATH, A.RELATE_IMAGE_NM, A.MENU_PAGE_TARGET, A.MENU_POPUPNFO , A.MENU_PAGE_TARGET, A.MENU_POPUPNFO, A.MENU_USEYN, A.MENU_PRIVACY , B.MENU_BASIC_INFO, B.ROLE_ID FROM COMTNMENUINFO A, COMTNMENUCREATDTLS B WHERE A.MENU_NO = B.MENU_NO AND B.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}

SELECT A.MENU_NO , A.MENU_ORDR , A.MENU_NM , A.UPPER_MENU_NO , (SELECT MENU_NM FROM COMTNMENUINFO WHERE MENU_NO = A.UPPER_MENU_NO) AS UPPER_MENU_NM , A.MENU_DC , A.PROGRM_FILE_NM , A.RELATE_IMAGE_PATH , A.RELATE_IMAGE_NM , A.MENU_PAGE_TARGET , A.MENU_POPUPNFO , A.MENU_PAGE_TARGET , A.MENU_POPUPNFO , A.MENU_USEYN , A.MENU_PRIVACY , A.MENU_CLASS FROM COMTNMENUINFO A INNER JOIN COMTNPROGRMLIST B ON A.PROGRM_FILE_NM = B.PROGRM_FILE_NM WHERE MENU_NO = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNMENUINFO ( MENU_NO , MENU_ORDR , MENU_NM , UPPER_MENU_NO, MENU_DC, PROGRM_FILE_NM, RELATE_IMAGE_PATH, RELATE_IMAGE_NM, MENU_PAGE_TARGET, MENU_POPUPNFO, MENU_USEYN, MENU_PRIVACY, MENU_ICON_TYPE, MENU_CLASS, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ) VALUES ( #{menuNo}::numeric, #{menuOrdr}::numeric, #{menuNm}, #{upperMenuNo}::numeric, #{menuDc ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{progrmFileNm}, #{relateImagePath ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{relateImageNm ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{menuPageTarget ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{menuPopupnfo ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{menuUseyn,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{menuPrivacy}, #{menuIconType ,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{menuClass ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update:

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(MENU_NO) AS totcnt FROM COMTNMENUINFO

SELECT B.MENU_NO , B.MENU_ORDR , B.MENU_NM , B.UPPER_MENU_NO , B.MENU_DC , B.RELATE_IMAGE_PATH , B.RELATE_IMAGE_NM , B.PROGRM_FILE_NM , (SELECT C.URL FROM LETTNPROGRMLIST C WHERE B.PROGRM_FILE_NM = C.PROGRM_FILE_NM) AS chkURL FROM COMTNMENUCREATDTLS A, COMTNMENUINFO B WHERE B.MENU_NO > 0 AND (B.UPPER_MENU_NO = 0 OR B.UPPER_MENU_NO IS NULL) AND A.MENU_NO = B.MENU_NO AND A.AUTHOR_CODE = (SELECT C.AUTHOR_CODE FROM COMTNEMPLYRSCRTYESTBS C WHERE C.SCRTY_DTRMN_TRGET_ID = #{empno}) ORDER BY MENU_ORDR

WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( /* [Root 단계] 최상위 메뉴 추출 */ SELECT a.MENU_NO, a.MENU_ORDR, a.MENU_NM, a.UPPER_MENU_NO, a.MENU_DC, a.PROGRM_FILE_NM, b.PROGRM_KOREAN_NM, b.URL, a.RELATE_IMAGE_NM, a.MENU_PAGE_TARGET, a.MENU_POPUPNFO, a.MENU_CLASS, a.MENU_ICON_TYPE, 1 AS LEVEL, CAST(LPAD(CAST(a.MENU_NO AS VARCHAR), 5, '0') AS VARCHAR(100)) AS sort_path FROM COMTNMENUINFO a JOIN COMTNPROGRMLIST b ON a.PROGRM_FILE_NM = b.PROGRM_FILE_NM JOIN COMTNMENUCREATDTLS c ON a.MENU_NO = c.MENU_NO WHERE (a.UPPER_MENU_NO IS NULL) AND c.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
UNION ALL /* [Recursive 단계] 자식 메뉴 추출 */ SELECT ta.MENU_NO, ta.MENU_ORDR, ta.MENU_NM, ta.UPPER_MENU_NO, ta.MENU_DC, ta.PROGRM_FILE_NM, tb.PROGRM_KOREAN_NM, tb.URL, ta.RELATE_IMAGE_NM, ta.MENU_PAGE_TARGET, ta.MENU_POPUPNFO, ta.MENU_CLASS, ta.MENU_ICON_TYPE, cte.LEVEL + 1, CAST(CONCAT(cte.sort_path, '-', LPAD(CAST(ta.MENU_NO AS VARCHAR), 5, '0')) AS VARCHAR(100)) FROM COMTNMENUINFO ta JOIN COMTNPROGRMLIST tb ON ta.PROGRM_FILE_NM = tb.PROGRM_FILE_NM JOIN COMTNMENUCREATDTLS tc ON ta.MENU_NO = tc.MENU_NO INNER JOIN cte ON ta.UPPER_MENU_NO = cte.MENU_NO WHERE tc.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ) SELECT MENU_NO, MENU_ORDR, UPPER_MENU_NO, MENU_DC, PROGRM_FILE_NM, PROGRM_KOREAN_NM, URL, LEVEL, MENU_NM, sort_path AS ctg_path, RELATE_IMAGE_NM, MENU_PAGE_TARGET, MENU_POPUPNFO, MENU_CLASS, MENU_ICON_TYPE FROM cte ORDER BY sort_path ASC
SELECT URL FROM LETTNPROGRMLIST WHERE PROGRM_FILE_NM = (SELECT PROGRM_FILE_NM FROM COMTNMENUINFO WHERE MENU_NO = #{menuNo}::numeric)

SELECT COUNT(MENU_NO) FROM COMTNMENUINFO WHERE UPPER_MENU_NO = #{params.menuNo} AND MENU_ORDR = (SELECT MIN(MENU_ORDR) FROM COMTNMENUCREATDTLS A, COMTNMENUINFO B WHERE A.MENU_NO = B.MENU_NO AND A.AUTHOR_CODE = (SELECT AUTHOR_CODE FROM LETTNEMPLYRSCRTYESTBS WHERE SCRTY_DTRMN_TRGET_ID = #{params.empNo}) AND B.MENU_NO IN (SELECT MENU_NO FROM COMTNMENUINFO WHERE UPPER_MENU_NO = #{params.menuNo}))
